resources.string: Ngekhibhodi, cindezela Umcibisholo obheke kwesobunxele nobheke kwesokudla ndawonye ukuze uvule noma uvale ukuzulazula ngokhiye bemicibisholo. Uma kuvuliwe, okhiye bemicibisholo benza imiyalo, njengaku-VoiceOver ku-iOS. Shintsha umyalo wokhiye ngamunye womcibisholo ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi.

Ingoma elandelayo nethi Ingoma edlule kulawula imidiya, futhi kunganikezwa ukunyakaza noma okhiye ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo. Isilawuli sokufunda esithi Imodi yomsindo sishintsha phakathi kokuthi Umsindo, Dlidliza nokuthi Thulisa; siyengeze ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Izilawuli zokufunda.

Konke ukufakwa kwenkulumo ku-SandFly manje kusebenzisa ukubhalisa ngezwi kwe-SandFly: Bhala ngezwi, imibuzo mayelana nezithombe nesikrini, kanye nemiyalo yezwi. Ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthayipha, Ukubhalisa ngezwi, khetha ukubonwa kwenkulumo, njenge-Google ekudivayisi, i-Rambler noma i-Whisper, nokuthi i-AI ilungisa yini umbhalo. Okuthi Misa ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kokuthula kuqeda ukurekhoda ngemva kokuthula okukhethayo.

I-SandFly Pro iyisengezo esikhokhelwayo. I-ejenti yayo ye-AI isebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza esikhundleni sakho, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokusebenza namageyimu angasebenzi nezifundi zesikrini, futhi yenza imiyalo ye-SandFly, njengokushintsha isivinini senkulumo. Nikeza okuthi Qala noma umise umsebenzi we-ejenti ye-AI ukunyakaza noma ukhiye ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, bese usho noma uthayiphe umsebenzi. Ukuhlola ukuphepha kubuza ngaphambi kwezenzo ezibucayi, futhi ezinhlelweni zokusebenza zasebhange i-ejenti iyafunda kuphela. I-SandFly Pro futhi iyisevisi ye-AI yezincazelo zezithombe nezesikrini kanye nokubona bukhoma, ngaphandle kokhiye we-API. Thenga ikhodi noma ufake ikhodi ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, SandFly Pro.

Isethingi ngalinye manje likusikrini esiqanjwe ngalokho elikushintshayo, futhi isikrini esiyinhloko sifushane. Okuthi Imiyalo kubala wonke umyalo nokunyakaza kwawo nesinqamuleli sekhibhodi, futhi kukunikeza endaweni eyodwa. Okuthi Izilawuli zokufunda nokuthi Imenyu ye-SandFly kubala izinto zakho zamanje ngokulandelana, ukuze uzihambise noma uzisuse.

I-SandFly ingahumusha lokho ekushoyo. Nikeza okuthi Humusha umshwana wokugcina okhulunyiwe ukunyakaza noma ukhiye ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo. Ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuhumusha, khetha isevisi nezilimi, bese uvula okuthi Ukuhumusha okuzenzakalelayo kwenkulumo ngolunye ulimi, noma ukuhumusha izaziso. Ukuhumusha ekudivayisi kulanda ulimi ngalunye kanye bese kusebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

Okokufundisa okusha kufundisa i-SandFly isinyathelo ngesinyathelo: uzama ukunyakaza ngakunye, bese i-SandFly ikuhlola futhi isho okwenzekile. Kuvule ngaphansi kokuthi Amasethingi, Usizo nempendulo, Okokufundisa kwe-SandFly.
I-SandFly 0.2.0 inezakhi ezintsha ezisemakhasini alandelayo. Ukuze uziphinde uzifunde kamuva, vula okuthi Izakhi ezintsha ku-SandFly phezulu kwamasethingi e-SandFly.
